thread:
Jen: Quick heads-up — all-hands scheduled Wed Mar 25 10:00am PT (hybrid). Agenda draft: 1) Dedicated capacity GA callouts; 2) Privacy & data retention policy update; 3) Incident recap (last week's regional outage); 4) Product & hiring updates; 5) Q&A + AMA.

Jen: Please drop 1-2 bullets you want covered here or add to the intake form: https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-intake (helps us prioritize). Recording and notes will be posted after. :wave:

CalendarBot: Event created — Add to calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/3172468001 (conference room: Main Aud, Zoom link included)

Sam: Can we make sure there's a clear SLA slide for Dedicated (latency/credits/rollback)? I'll need 2 slides for partner demo.

Lina: Please include a short blurb on the new retention defaults for hosted API keys — customers will want clarity about KMS and opt-outs.

Mike: Also request: brief demo of Redwood Optimize cost-saving examples (2-3 concrete customer scenarios).

Olivia: I'll be OOO that day but will drop questions in the form. Can someone record the demo screens at native res? :thumbsup:

Jen: Noted — AV team will capture demo screens. Sam, Mike — can you coordinate slides with ProductOps by EOD Tue?

Maya: Copy — ProductOps will collect final slide deck. If you have data to share (charts/tables), upload to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/allhands/3172468001-deck by Tue 6pm PT.

Jen: One more ask — if you plan to call out any customer names or screenshots, please clear with Legal before the meeting. Tagging here for visibility: @LegalTeam

<<--- meeting happens --->>

Maya: Recording and notes are up: https://share.redwood.com/recordings/3172468001 All-hands recap + action items below.

Maya: TL;DR takeaways: 1) Dedicated capacity GA moved to next month — public launch plan + pricing doc linked in notes; 2) Data retention policy: hosted API default retention shortened to 30 days (customers can opt into longer retention or use Private deployment/KMS); 3) Incident recap: root cause was autoscaler race condition in multi-tenant pools — mitigation deployed and long-term fix scheduled; 4) Product: Optimize improvements (adaptive batching + KV prefetch) projected to reduce token cost by ~12% for typical chat workloads; 5) Hiring: priority reqs for SRE (2), Infra Eng (3), Product PM (1); links in notes.

Maya: Action items (owners): - Sam: Draft Dedicated SLA appendix (due Fri) - Lina: Update docs and retention policy page + publish changelog (due Thu) - Mike: Upload Optimize benchmark deck (due Wed) - Ops: Run a postmortem follow-up with customers impacted by outage (due Mon)

Sam: Thanks — filing the SLA appendix. Will ping Legal for wording review.

Lina: Policy doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/policy/data-retention-v2 (draft). I'll open a PR and add changelog entry once PR is green.

LegalTeam: Noted. We'll review the SLA appendix and the customer screenshots — please send draft by EOD Fri.

Jen: Great work — appreciative of the concise demos. Team, please review the notes and pick any follow-ups you own. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Eng + Product to firm up rollout comms. :eyes:

Olivia: Watched the recording — looks solid, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Maya: Closing note: If anyone wants to suggest a future all-hands topic (deep-dive on quantization, on-prem install walk-through, etc.), add it to this doc: https://docs.redwood.com/allhands-ideas
